title: Historic Nashville White House!
description:
Close To Downtown & Greenway, Sleeps 12, Fenced Yard!!
Luxurious Nashville home in the heart of music city. 4 private BR's & 6 total beds- smart Tv's in each BR, pillow top mattresses & themed antique furnishings. Walking Distance to Dose coffee and great restaurants!  3 full BA's--dual ceiling/wall shower heads, body sprayers, & jacuzzi tub complimenting additional master bath. 2 sets of washer & dryers for large groups! Bright kitchen with high end appliances! Huge back deck! Superfast Wifi!

The space
This is a soundproof multifamily home with a separate unit for long term tenant. Your home space is completely private with your own driveway and ample parking, private entry, private front fenced in yard, and private large furnished back deck with private grill. No major stairs and the floor plan is all on one level--a rarity for a home this big--perfect for families or Senior groups!
